items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: We had Lee, a fellow by the name of Lee, playing voice alto, I mean third alto, Emile Fritz tenor, Elliot Taylor, voice sax, Richard McNein, guitar, a fellow by the name of Charles, bass, Sently J, trumpet.

ctx.x: Reading band, yeah. We had ten pieces, eleven pieces with the piano. Who was he meant to? We had Lee, a fellow by the name of Lee, playing voice alto, I mean third alto, Emile Fritz tenor, Elliot Taylor, voice sax, Richard McNein, guitar, a fellow by the name of Charles, bass, Sently J, trumpet. Who? Sently J, Anthony Sently J.
Yeah, I never did know him.
